status: FINAL TEXT, NOT TAGGED. Real labels may be read only by src/run_registry_v3.py after the features-v3 and registry-v3 tags exist and every manifest hash matches.

settings.split_rule: group-level stratified K-fold (train_regression_v3.grouped_splits): sklearn StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True) applied to the unique split_group units, group stratum = severity_class of the group's first (lowest-ID) member, folds expanded to all members. Outer: random_state = split_seed + repeat for repeat 0..9; inner (alpha selection inside each outer training fold): random_state = split_seed, same strata and groups.
settings.split_rule_change: Replaces sklearn StratifiedGroupKFold(shuffle=True) named at the registry review: on the synthetic test data (Kaggle, commit 59dea01) it produced an 8-subject validation fold that was entirely one class (share 1.0 vs 0.56 overall) and others at 0.25-0.33. Groups were never split in either version; only the class balance changes. Found with synthetic data only, before the registry-v3 tag.
settings.imputer_rule: SimpleImputer(strategy='median') fitted inside every training fold (inner and outer), before StandardScaler; primary features have no missing values
settings.permutation_rule: joint permutation of (nihss_raw, severity_class) across subjects; groups stay attached to recordings; splits regenerated from the permuted strata with the same seeds; p = (1 + #{null >= observed}) / (1 + B) for 'greater', (1 + #{|null| >= |observed|}) / (1 + B) for 'two-sided'

cohort.rule: main = include_v3_epochs in features/v3/epoch_qc_v3.csv (N 45); lesion = main with lesion_side_final left/right in subject_meta_v3 (N 38)

labels.sha256_note: Canonical hash of the committed (LF) label file. The features-v3 MANIFEST label_file entry (951ee16b...) was computed from a CRLF Windows working copy of the same content (erratum, see V3_STEP8_PREP_REPORT.md); the runner verifies the label file against sha256_lf instead.
labels.class_rule: mild = NIHSS 1-4 (0), moderate = NIHSS 5-11 (1); asserted against nihss_raw

crosscheck.rule: run_registry_v3.py refuses to run if NIHSS differs from nihss_raw for any of the 45 subjects

groups.note: near-identical recordings sub-11/15 and sub-47/49 share a group

tests.question: Corrected spectral asymmetry (pdBSI, averaged-spectrum Step 3b) vs NIHSS
Ipsilesional-minus-contralesional delta asymmetry (more ipsilesional slowing) vs NIHSS
Noise-free hemispheric graph deformation (cross-half core edge D2, all bands) vs NIHSS
Ridge prediction of NIHSS from the 8 core cross-half D2 features

decision_rule: signal detected only if Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND |rho| >= 0.30; otherwise 'no effect detected'

sensitivities.rule: Outside Holm; estimates only (no p-values, no confidence intervals, no model promotion, no claims)

S1.V4: Ridge with n_epochs added as a ninth feature

S2.note: Ridge computed only if each class has >= 5 subjects in the subgroup; otherwise reported as not computable

S3.what: exclude subjects with core edges that have one interpolated endpoint

S5.note: V1-V3: AUC of the scalar; V4: AUC of out-of-fold predictions

S7.what: v2 primary T1-T9 next to v3 V1-V4
S7.note: report table only; v2 results are not recomputed

S9.what: drop one member of each near-duplicate pair (keep the lower ID)

positive_control.pass: p < 0.01 for both the ridge and the association engine

null_calibration.pass: exact 95% binomial CI of the false-positive rate contains 0.05, for both engines

shuffled_smoke.pass: runs without error on shuffled labels; rho reported (expected near 0)
